selection.name: Ice Path
selection.description: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Creates a level 2 Macropyre on top of the Ice Path.

selection.name: Ice Shards
selection.description: The caster compresses shards of ice into a ball of frozen energy that damages all enemies it comes in contact with. When the ball reaches its target destination the shards are released, creating a barrier that lasts for 4 / 5 / 6 / 7 seconds.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Reduces the cooldown by 6s. Enemies trapped within an ice shard suffer from 40% slow and take 60 damage per second. Increases Ice Shards depth by 300 units.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Damage per second and movespeed affect entire arena while an Ice Shard is active.

selection.name: Infernal Blade
selection.description: The hero lands an infernal attack, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.6 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
selection.differences: Applies a Break for %break_duration% seconds by default.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: +1.2s ministun duration, +2.1% max HP burn, and bonus damage.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Infernal Blade's effects are applied to all enemies within 500 radius of the primary target.

selection.name: Ink Swell
selection.description: The caster shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it triggers, applying damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
selection.differences: AI: targets frontliners in cast range. Otherwise, closest unit. Has max cast range at all levels, and slightly reduced radius.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Increases radius by 150, movement speed bonus by 16%, damage by 40% and reduces cooldown by 5s. Heal the target for 40% of the damage dealt. Upon expiration, the target will receive a strong dispell.

selection.name: Inner Beast
selection.description: Untaps the inner fury of nearby allies, passively increasing their attack speed.
selection.superUpgrade: Super: Grants an aura that grants 20% lifesteal and 15% bonus damage. Increases attack speed by 15.
selection.gabenUpgrade: Gaben: Summons a Wraith Pact at the beginning of battle, which emits an aura that reduces physical damage from enemies by 30% and deals 30 damage per second. Increases attack speed by 15.
